candidates.title: Direct Singleton Service Access

evidence.description: Declaration of a global/static mutable var
Write to the global/static mutable var

candidates.explanation: The `User` struct contains a `shared` static property that is a mutable `var`. This global state is modified (via `didSet`) and read without any visible actor isolation or synchronization mechanism, which can lead to data races when accessed from multiple concurrency contexts.
candidates.title: Unprotected Mutable Global or Static State

evidence.description: Creation of an unstructured Task.detached without lifecycle management or cancellation

candidates.explanation: The `save()` method creates an unstructured `Task.detached` that captures `self` (via the `user` local variable) to perform file I/O. This task has no visible cancellation or lifecycle management, meaning it could outlive the operation that initiated it.
candidates.title: Unstructured Concurrency Without Appropriate Lifecycle Management
